entries.root_cause: the fit rule counts a Mac box total memory, while Metal can only give a model its working set, so small Macs are over-placed

attempts.action: fit rule: m4mini capacity = 11.4 GB (its Metal working set: llama.cpp recommendedMaxWorkingSetSize 12,713 MB, Strata workSet 11.8 GiB) instead of 16 GB; other boxes keep total memory
attempts.rationale: the existing 14.5 GB MiniCPM-V row on m4mini had to run hybrid (32/40 layers) while 10.7 GB files run fully resident, which a 16 GB budget cannot explain and an ~11.4 GB working set does

predicted.note: written with the edit (18:08), before kpi.py first ran but after the round-0 Inkling measurements; predicts C unchanged by the edit and fewer m4mini placements

observed.note: m4mini Q4_K_M placements drop for every 20-36B candidate; the 8.49 GB Inkling IQ2_XXS file ran resident on m4mini at pp512/tg128, consistent with the cap. Same round: Strata 0.2.19 on m4mini served token id 0 for every reply while its own --bench and --selfcheck passed, so a correctness probe (17 x 23) now gates every published rate.
